caseName: 信息密度与反模式规避
prompt: 请基于项目的 real.md、cog.md 和 pr.spec.md，将 MAS-3（导出方案，动手组装）拆解为用户故事。请严格遵循信息密度规则：每行通过测试'cog.md + real.md + pr.spec.md + AI 通用知识都不含这个信息吗？'。约束必须用引用而非复制。
expectedBehavior: 输出应体现高信息密度：约束使用引用格式，不复制上游文档内容，不填充通用知识，故事聚焦用户可感知变化。

expectations.description: All constraint fields use reference format (e.g., '见 real.md §C3') rather than copying text from real.md
CS is derived from actual MAS-3 affordance sequence, not generic category names like '导出功能' or '核心功能'
Each MS's 用户可感知变化 describes what user sees/feels, not implementation details (file format internals, JSON schema, CAD engine, WASM)
Output includes at least one MS-D (with 正常态/异变/恢复 judgment) and one MS-G (with 循环模式/优化点/习惯形成 judgment)
Each MS has 故事评判 with type-matching field labels: 光明→起点/转折/终点, 黑暗→正常态/异变/恢复, 灰色→循环模式/优化点/习惯形成
No sentences reproduce general industry knowledge (what STEP is, BOM definitions, machining tolerances); every substantive sentence references upstream or asserts ALPDesigner-specific behavior
